subject: Cascade.ai: identity controls & provisioning questionnaire — Redwood responses
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cascade.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mira Patel <mira.patel@cascade.ai>, procurement@cascade.ai
Date: 2026-07-12 08:14 -0700
Subject: Cascade — quick follow up on identity controls questionnaire

Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We attached our identity & access controls questionnaire (short version) and a few follow-ups that the compliance team is asking for. The ask: can Redwood confirm support for our provisioning model (SCIM 2.0 with group-sync + custom attribute mapping), SSO options (SAML + OIDC), and how role administration maps to your RBAC model?

High-level timeline: we need vendor responses for our security review by EOD Friday (2026-07-16). If you can point to any artifacts (SOC2, SCIM API docs) and the specific admin flows we should expect, that would be ideal.

Best,
Alex
Senior IT Security Program Manager
Cascade.ai

Attachments: cascade_identity_questionnaire_v1.docx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cascade.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12 11:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Cascade — quick follow up on identity controls questionnaire

Alex — thanks for the packet. Looping in Karthik from product (SSO/SCIM owner) and Laura from security for the artifacts. We can meet if you want a walkthrough, but below are the quick answers and I'll attach our SCIM mapping and SOC2 attestation.

Quick summary:
- SSO: We support both SAML 2.0 and OIDC (RP). We commonly do SAML for older IdPs and OIDC for modern OIDC-compatible providers; both support JIT provisioning via attribute exchange.
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 (RFC7644) mostly complete for users and groups. We support group-sync, enterpriseExtensions for custom attributes, and bulk replace semantics on group membership.
- RBAC: Role-based model exposed via Admin Console + API. Roles are: Viewer, Developer, Operator, Admin, and Custom Roles (scoped by resource). Role assignment can be done via SCIM group-to-role mapping or via the Admin API.

Artifacts attached: SOC2-Attestation-Redwood-2025.pdf; SCIM_API_Spec-2026-07.pdf; Cascade_Redwood_SCIM_MAP_v2.xlsx (example mapping).

If you need a single-page mapping table for your procurement sheet, Karthik — can you add a short summary stanza?

— Hannah
Director, GTM Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cascade.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13 09:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Cascade — quick follow up on identity controls questionnaire

Alex — quick technical notes and a short bulleted mapping for your procurement checklist.

SCIM provisioning and mapping (highlights):
- Supported endpoints: /Users, /Groups, /ServiceProviderConfig, /Schemas. PATCH, POST, PUT supported; recommended pattern: PATCH for incremental updates.
- Group sync: we support group membership push from IdP -> Redwood. We also support bidirectional group metadata via a dedicated admin API (non-SCIM) when customers need group metadata back in their IdP.
- Attribute mapping: custom attributes live under enterpriseExtensions:urn:redwood:attrs. Common mapped attributes: employeeNumber -> externalId, title -> jobTitle, manager -> managerExternalId, costCenter -> custom:cost_center. We included a sample mapping (Cascade_Redwood_SCIM_MAP_v2.xlsx).
- Deprovisioning: SCIM delete /Users/{id} will remove access; we also support soft-delete (disabled flag) for 90 days retention before hard-delete.
- JIT provisioning: for OIDC, we support JIT via claims mapping; for SAML we accept attribute-based provisioning triggers.

RBAC and admin controls (highlights):
- Roles model: named roles + resource scoping. Custom roles can be created via Admin Console or Admin API and scoped to model endpoints, workspace, or project level.
- Entitlement sync: recommend creating IdP groups that map to role bindings in Redwood. We support SCIM group -> role binding policy: groupMembers become role-assigned users on sync.
- Delegated admin: you can designate ‘Workspace Owner’ roles with limited admin privileges; these owners can manage users but not billing.
- Audit logging: admin changes and role assignments are logged to the tenant audit stream and retained for 365 days (longer retention available as an enterprise add-on). Logs include actor, target, before/after payloads, and requestId.

Operational notes:
- Service accounts: create via Admin Console or API; SCIM is not used for service accounts — instead we issue scoped API keys with optional short TTLs and rotation hooks.
- Rate limits: SCIM endpoints have per-tenant rate limits (configured in Dedicated/Private deployments). We provide exponential backoff guidance in our SCIM doc.

If Cascade wants, we can prepare a 1-page table mapping your questionnaire rows to our responses (I can do that today).

— Karthik
Product Manager, Identity & Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Mira Patel <mira.patel@cascade.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cascade.ai>, procurement@cascade.ai
Date: 2026-07-14 10:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Cascade — quick follow up on identity controls questionnaire

Thanks — this is very helpful. A few clarifying questions from our security team so we can close the RFP row items: 

1) Soft-delete: you said 90 days before hard-delete — can that be configured per-tenant? Our policy requires 180 days for deprovisioning hold for legal reasons.
2) Audit logs: what format do logs land in (JSON lines, syslog) and do you provide real-time streaming options to our SIEM (S3/CloudWatch/EventHub)?
3) Service accounts: can they be included in SCIM groups for permissioning (they are created via API today in our environment and we'd prefer a group-based approach)?
4) SCIM bulk operations: do you support bulk replace for groups >10k members or will customers need to chunk updates?

We may accept SOC2 PDF but would prefer an attestation letter with registered auditor contact — is that available?

If you can answer inline, we can mark the items as closed and move this to procurement for contracting.

— Mira
Security Operations
Cascade.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mira Patel <mira.patel@cascade.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@cascade.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15 16:48 -0700
Subject: Re: Cascade — quick follow up on identity controls questionnaire

Mira — answers inline.

1) Soft-delete retention: We support configurable soft-delete retention windows for Dedicated and Private deployments; for Hosted (our default) we can negotiate a 180-day soft-delete retention on the contract for your org. It will be written into the data retention clause.

2) Audit logs: Logs are emitted in JSON Lines (ndjson) and we provide delivery options: S3 transfer (recommended), CloudWatch, and a push-based webhook for real-time ingest. We also support streaming to customer SIEMs via a configurable connector (we’ll include the connector spec link).

3) Service accounts in groups: We do support provisioning of service accounts into SCIM groups when customers choose to manage service accounts via SCIM. By default our managed service-account flow issues API keys and those keys can be represented as objects in SCIM under an extension (serviceAccount:true). If you want group-based permissioning for service accounts, mark service accounts with the serviceAccount attribute and include them in group membership payloads — our mapping supports it.

4) SCIM bulk ops: Our SCIM API supports bulk endpoint semantics for up to 10k operations per call. For groups >10k members we recommend chunking; if you have predictable large scale (hundreds of thousands of users) we can provide a bulk-sync connector or S3-based CSV import during onboarding.

SOC2 attestation: we can provide an auditor contact and an attestation letter. Ben — please add the link to the auditor contact and a short attestation letter to the Drive folder.

Next steps: Hannah/procurement — if you want I can draft the one-page mapping matching your questionnaire fields to these responses and include contract language for the 180-day retention option.

— Laura
Head of Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SOC2-Attestation-Redwood-2025.pdf, Cascade_Redwood_SCIM_MAP_v2.xlsx
